entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, finally. I need to return this jersey I bought. It's completely useless to me and this is the third time I've tried calling.
I certainly apologize for any difficulty you've had reaching us. I can definitely look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! It's so ridiculously tight I can barely get it on. I need to return it. It's that simple.
Okay, I understand. So the fit is the concern. I can help with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Look, I don't have time to dig around for numbers. Just look up my account. The name is Mark Shapiro. If you can't handle this, put me through to your manager right now. I'm about to leave a review that your company won't like.

I understand your frustration, Mark. I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. I'm pulling up your account now... I see an order for the ClubFit Jersey delivered about 45 days ago. Is that the one?
Yes, that's the one. So are you going to give me some garbage excuse about it being too long?

Not at all. I've checked the policy, and for our standard apparel items like that jersey, we have a 10-day return window. Since you're unfortunately outside that time, I can process this for you right now. We can do a full refund or an exchange for a larger size.
Wait, really? A full refund? No restocking fee or anything?
That's correct. No fees. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear. Since the jersey was the wrong size and too tight, would you like me to set up an exchange for the next size up?
No, no, just the refund is fine. I'll figure out what I want later. So what do I do?

Perfectly fine. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label and instructions to the email we have on file for you. Just print the label, pack the item, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Oh. Okay then. That's... better than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mark. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
